WebinarClonesAI Review 2026 — My Honest Take After Testing Jono Armstrong's DFY Webinar System

If you've been in affiliate marketing for any length of time, you know the name Jono Armstrong. ClickBank top vendor. Super affiliate. The guy who consistently produces launches that actually convert.

So when I saw his new product — WebinarClonesAI — landing on JVZoo on May 12, 2026, I paid attention. And after digging deep into exactly what it does and how it works, I'm writing this review to give you the full picture before you decide.

Let me be direct: this isn't a page stuffed with hype. I'll walk you through what WebinarClonesAI actually is, what you get, what the upsells cost, and whether it's worth your money.

What Is WebinarClonesAI?

WebinarClonesAI is a done-for-you webinar platform that lets you deploy 5 pre-built, pre-recorded webinar funnels in minutes — without creating any content yourself.

The core idea is simple: webinars are the highest-converting sales tool online (20–50% of attendees buy at the end), but building one from scratch has historically been expensive, time-consuming, and technically complex.

WebinarClonesAI removes every barrier. You don't record anything. You don't write scripts. You don't build funnels. You don't pay for EverWebinar or Zoom. You just log in, paste your affiliate link, click save — and your webinar is live, hosted, and selling 24/7.

The webinars were created by Jono Armstrong, Alan Magliocca, and proven top earners. They're already converting. You're deploying something that already works.

Who Is WebinarClonesAI For?

  • Affiliate marketers who want a high-converting promotional vehicle without creating content
  • Complete beginners who've never run a webinar or built a funnel
  • Email marketers looking for a fresh, high-converting offer to promote to their list
  • Anyone who's avoided webinars because of the cost or complexity — that barrier is now gone

If you have zero tech skills, zero list, and zero experience with webinars — WebinarClonesAI was built specifically for you.

How It Works — 3 Steps

The process is genuinely simple:

  1. Log In & Choose a Webinar — Pick one of the 5 pre-built webinar funnels inside your dashboard. Each is fully recorded, scripted, and designed.
  2. Paste Your Affiliate Link — One paste. The system swaps in your link automatically. Works with any URL — affiliate links, your own products, anything.
  3. Click Save & Go Live — Your webinar is instantly hosted and running 24/7. No Zoom subscription needed. No external hosting fees.

That's it. From there, the system handles email follow-ups, SMS sequences, chat responses, dynamic CTAs, and replay routing — all automatically.

Key Features Breakdown

5 DFY Webinar Funnels

The crown jewel. You get 5 complete webinar funnels built by proven top earners. Each includes the full webinar recording, a professional landing/registration page, thank-you page, and post-webinar follow-up sequence. Early buyers get 10 funnels.

Zero Ongoing Costs

No EverWebinar ($99/month). No Zoom ($15+/month). No Webinarjam. The platform is fully hosted at no additional charge. This alone makes WebinarClonesAI dramatically more affordable than traditional webinar setups.

Live Chat Simulation

The system displays preloaded FAQs and handles common objections in chat automatically. You can also manage chat in real-time from your back office. AI chatbot integration is coming soon.

Dynamic CTAs & Behavioral Triggers

Multiple calls-to-action appear and disappear at strategically timed moments. You can trigger different follow-up sequences based on poll answers, early exits, button clicks, or abandoned checkouts.

Built-in Email & SMS Follow-Up

Connect your existing autoresponder or let WebinarClonesAI collect and store leads internally. Automatic follow-up sequences fire after the first run — no setup required beyond that initial connection.

Organic AI Traffic Optimization

Built-in optimization for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity — the fastest-growing free traffic sources online right now. Your webinar funnels are structured to get discovered by AI search engines.

Replay Routing

Visitors who don't attend the live webinar are automatically routed to replay versions, maximizing your conversion window.

The OTOs (Upsells) — What They Cost & What You Get

WebinarClonesAI has 5 upsells. Here's the honest breakdown:

OTO 1: WebinarClonesAI Partnership — $97

Jono hands you his entire digital business — all his internal strategies, ad templates, pages, scripts, emails, automations, and connections to pre-trained virtual assistants. This is for people who want to build the same business Jono has, not just promote one product. If you're serious about scaling, this is worth considering.

OTO 2: WebinarClonesAI Recurring Partners — $77

Converts your webinar leads into monthly recurring income. You refer leads to a done-for-you recurring service, they handle fulfillment, you earn monthly commissions. Stack multiple referrals for a predictable income stream without extra traffic. One of the more interesting upsells here.

OTO 3: WebinarClonesAI Empire — $127

Full agency mode. Edit, customize, and brand everything. Charge clients $1K–$5K per webinar setup. Multiple income streams from one system. If you plan to sell webinar services to businesses, this is the unlock you need.

OTO 4: WebinarClonesAI DFY — $147

The team builds your entire setup for you. All 5 webinar funnels are set up, affiliate links plugged in, everything connected and tested. You just send traffic. If you want zero learning curve whatsoever, this is your option.

OTO 5: WebinarClonesAI Whitelabel — $499

Own the platform. Sell WebinarClonesAI under your own brand, keep 100% of profits, build your own affiliate army. This is for experienced marketers who want an asset — not just a tool.

Pros & Cons

✅ Pros

  • Genuinely removes the #1 barrier to webinar marketing (content creation)
  • Trusted vendor — Jono Armstrong has a proven track record of delivering
  • No monthly platform fees — massive cost saving vs. traditional webinar tools
  • Works for complete beginners — truly 3-step setup
  • Built-in AI traffic optimization — future-proofed for the AI search era
  • Real proof: $41,904 in 14 days using the exact system
  • Works for any niche or offer — paste any link

❌ Cons

  • You're running someone else's webinar content — less personal branding unless you upgrade to Empire/Whitelabel
  • Best results still require traffic (paid or organic) — the system converts traffic, it doesn't generate it by itself
  • Full potential requires at least OTO 2 or 3 to unlock recurring income or agency scalability
  • Only 7-day launch window (May 12–19) — urgency is real but limited

My Verdict — Is WebinarClonesAI Worth $37?

Yes. For $37 you get access to a proven, hosted, done-for-you webinar system built by one of the most trusted names in digital marketing. The three-step setup is real. The zero-platform-cost promise is real. The conversions are documented.

Webinar marketing converts at 20–50%. Nothing else in digital marketing comes close. WebinarClonesAI gives you access to that format without any of the traditional barriers.

If you're an affiliate marketer who wants a new, high-converting asset — or a beginner who wants to start earning without creating content — this is a strong buy at the front-end price.

Rating: 4.6 / 5

The main reason it's not a 5/5 is that you're deploying Jono's webinars rather than your own branded content. But for most affiliates at this price point, that's not a limitation — it's the entire point.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to create any video content?

No. All 5 webinar funnels are pre-recorded and ready to deploy. You never appear on camera or record anything.

Do I need a Zoom or EverWebinar subscription?

No. The system is fully hosted at no additional cost. There are zero ongoing platform fees.

What niche does this work for?

Any niche. You paste your affiliate link or any URL and the system swaps it in. The webinar converts the traffic — your link determines where commissions go.

Do I need an email list to start?

No. You can drive traffic directly to the webinar registration page. The system collects and follows up with leads automatically.

When does it launch?

May 12, 2026 at 11:00 AM Eastern. The cart closes May 19, 2026 — 7-day launch window.

Is the front-end price guaranteed?

The $37 front-end price is the launch price. It will likely increase after the launch window closes.
